payload.title: Calibration of the Sr/Ca paleothermometer: a frequentist approach
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates the calibration of coral Sr/Ca measurements to sea surface temperature (SST) using a frequentist approach, specifically Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) and Weighted Least Squares (WLS) regression. The data used for calibration is sourced from DeLong et al. (2011) and involves coral samples from Dry Tortugas.
